title: Decide: apply the /u/ user-URI rule to remote users' URIs
description: Follow-up to decisions mimid-1wgh.6.76/.6.79 (local users done). Remote users' URIs are checked by domain only at follower/consent.rs (remote URI), hub/key_material.rs:107,134 and hub/update.rs:421,461,672-673. protocol-07 §2.1 makes /u/ the user-URI form. Decide for Mark: refuse non-/u/ remote user URIs at these sites? Caveat: in hub/update.rs the same check sees senders, and the hub's own identity is the provider URI mimi://<domain> (decision .6.35), so that site needs to tell users from the hub.
